cover_letter.letter:
My name is Alex Gonzalez. I am passionate about working with creative individuals and challenging myself alongside the best engineers and artists in the world. I thrive on projects that are wild, challenging, and can stress test my life's skillset.

I enjoy teaching and enjoy working with students on creative projects, regardless of their familiarity with my field. I teach various programs a couple of times a year, ranging from renowned film centers to humble startup library after-school programs.

Currently, I reside in New Haven, CT, surrounded by a vibrant network of friends, fellow developers, and the arts and church community. I have an office above MakeHaven, a paradise for meeting like-minded individuals.

I am seeking an organization that values creativity and innovation, where I can freely create ideas and prototypes. I believe I would thrive in an environment where the focus is not solely on financial gain but on exploratory and visionary work, bringing forth new technology and ideas.

I have a proven track record, having won hackathons and served as the core principle idea man at my previous companies. For the last three years, I served as a creative director at a startup blockchain software development company. I led multiple teams, managed projects, and built products from scratch.

I am eager to apply the lessons I've learned from my past experiences to help others and try again, this time wiser, stronger, and more capable. I am the silver bullet you won't regret. Please feel free to contact me.

Best regards,
Alex
